tool.static_side_tool: Vivado v2025.2 (SW Build 6299465) for lint; python 3.13 for the syntactic pass

static_classification.method: per always_ff block, identifiers assigned inside `if (!rst_n)` versus outside; `<=` matches at parenthesis depth 0 only, so comparisons such as (active_size <= 7'd4) are not mistaken for assignments

category_1_must_reset_control_state.verdict: No missing control reset identified by syntactic scan; completeness NOT_PROVEN

category_2_write_before_read.key_argument: scrub_index runs 0..INPUT_VALID_WORDS-1 and writes valid=0 into all four banks each cycle (unified_its_wrapper.sv:1718-1722), and reads are blocked while scrub_active; the early-exit path scrub_ended also requires scrub_index == INPUT_VALID_WORDS-1 (:559-561), so validity is always fully cleared before any read
category_2_write_before_read.verdict: PROVISIONAL: establish initialization/write-before-read for each memory independently

category_3_valid_masked.evidence: data and validity travel together: unified_its_wrapper.sv:2185-2190 and :1340-1343
category_3_valid_masked.verdict: PROVISIONAL: per-path pairing assertions and dynamic checks required

category_4_unproven.path: data_mem holds arbitrary post-power-up content in hardware and is never cleared
category_4_unproven.status: masked by valid_mem; the argument rests on scrub completeness, which is structural, not a reset guarantee
category_4_unproven.close_by: assert that scrub covers the full bank, or a directed read-before-scrub check

category_4_unproven.status: dynamic X coverage reaches only 24 output beats

category_4_unproven.path: 4-state simulation substitutes for the design: `if (valid_mem[..])` takes X as false, coincidentally matching 'treat as invalid'
category_4_unproven.status: open; this is why 'no X in simulation' cannot be promoted to 'trustworthy in hardware'
category_4_unproven.close_by: Prove/observe valid_mem is known on each effective read, full scrub/first-write precedes read, and payload validity pairing holds. Replacing if(valid) by ===1 alone does not close this item.

negative_control.mutation: removed the `desc_count <= 2'd0;` assignment from the reset branch (unified_its_wrapper.sv:1837)
negative_control.interpretation: the suite is sensitive to a missing reset on control state

review_corrections.scope: Historical dynamic results retained; syntactic audit is not a proof of reset completeness.
review_corrections.category_1: No missing control reset identified by this syntactic scan; not a complete proof.
review_corrections.category_2: Per-memory write-before-read argument required; bank scrub does not prove safety of every unrelated memory.
review_corrections.category_3: Validity pairing requires per-path checks; previous structural closed wording withdrawn.
